venture.name: Threshold Fit
venture.concept: AI guided fitness subscription that brings meals, warm-ups, exercise, stretches and reminders into one app.
venture.primary_product: Personalized fitness and meal planning app
venture.target_customers: Busy adults with limited time; earlier notes also mention stable income and all ages.
venture.value_proposition: One place to manage a fitness journey, with practical guidance around the user’s goals and schedule.
venture.geographic_market: Global ambition stated by the founder
distribution_channels: iOS and Android stores and direct web subscriptions (research assumptions, not confirmed launch choices)
venture.differentiation_status: Proposed and unproven. Bundling and personalization already exist in competitors.
research_assumptions: US pricing in USD is used as a comparable market slice; it is not a decision to abandon the global ambition.
The latest busy-adult target supersedes the earlier all-ages segment.
No venture name, final platforms, launch country, costs or willingness-to-pay results were supplied.
venture.prior_research_context: Workspace reports a small App Store review sample and a food-data completeness exercise. These were not revalidated. The AI focus group is fictional and supports hypotheses only.
venture.name_source: Name observed in original venture website src/App.tsx on 2026-10-27; Mission 1 itself was unnamed.
venture.confirmed: AI fitness companion concept for busy adults; proposed workouts, meals, warm-ups, stretches and reminders.
venture.assumptions: US/USD launch slice, paid subscription, a remote founder, contractor support and all-store revenue are scenarios. No physical inventory, office lease or full-time hires are assumed.

websites.note: Setup supplied a Pages live URL in the repository field. Preserved verbatim; the matching repository was inspected read-only.
